text: 万科Ａ公告，A股股票连续三个交易日（2026年9月18日、9月21日、9月22日）收盘价格涨幅偏离值累计超过20%，属于股票交易异常波动。近期公司经营情况稳定，内外部经营环境未发生重大变化。
text_en: China Vanke A announced that the closing price deviation of its A-shares exceeded 20% cumulatively over three consecutive trading days (September 18, September 21, and September 22, 2026), constituting abnormal stock trading fluctuation. Recently, the company's operating conditions have been stable, and no major changes have occurred in the internal and external operating environment.
